# name script

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:nameScript`](gmeow-nameScript.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/nameScript>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The ISO 15924 script code of an appellation (e.g. "Hani", "Arab", "Latn"). Available explicitly for indexing alongside a BCP-47 script subtag on the literal.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Appellation`](../classes/gmeow-Appellation.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:nameScript`](gmeow-nameScript.md) from [`gmeow:Appellation`](../classes/gmeow-Appellation.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Appellation`](../classes/gmeow-Appellation.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the ISO 15924 script of an appellation explicitly for indexing — alongside any BCP-47 script subtag already on the [`gmeow:fullName`](gmeow-fullName.md) literal.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for the language (that is [`gmeow:nameLanguage`](gmeow-nameLanguage.md), a first-class [`gmeow:Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md)) and avoid an invented script code — use the ISO 15924 value.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:nameScript`](gmeow-nameScript.md) to the ISO 15924 code on an appellation when the script must be queried directly rather than parsed from the literal's BCP-47 subtag.

### Examples

- ex:yamadaName [`gmeow:nameScript`](gmeow-nameScript.md) "Jpan".
